description: Adopt SQLSpec typing patterns for optional dependencies (pyarrow, pgvector, numpy) with lazy evaluation, Protocol stubs, and extension support.
implementation_notes: Implemented OptionalDependencyFlag with lazy evaluation, Protocol-based stubs for Arrow/NumPy/PgVector, ensure_*() functions with clear error messages, updated broker.py and provider.py to use new patterns. Tests added for module_loader and arrow_typing.
